anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After keeps the retries-twice correction with the original verbatim in the Reporter note and premise line, leaves the reporter observation and the uncheckable preference untouched, keeps the uncited wrapper and clears the uncited AC-fit, supplies /repos/viewer and /repos/billing plus the pre-rendered missing line in the prepare checkpoint with the https-cloned viewer found beside PRIMARY, groups only the grounded viewer leg under team/viewer, names the attachments without reading them, preserves the 12-row expected result, and reports the three degradation outcomes correctly. Two things weaken After relative to Before without crossing a fact line: the Idea diff's old side omits the snapshot's first line 'reporter proposes preserving report rows on download.' (the diff is not a faithful old->new of the fetched body) and the new Idea line silently drops that reporter goal while keeping the wrapper sentence in both the Idea and the Reporter note, which Before avoided by retaining the attributed sketch line and demoting only the extra mechanism line; and After no longer states explicitly that team/viewer is the final two segments of the stored origin at /repos/viewer, leaving the derivation to be inferred from the table. To keep every fact robustly while delivering the Change, keep Before's Idea handling (retain the reporter's one attributed sketch line, demote the ExportWrapper line verbatim, add the repo names), render the diff against the exact snapshot lines, and keep one sentence naming the stored-origin-derived repo name beside the found absolute path.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: the premise correction line, verbatim Reporter note, byte-identical reporter observation with its cited ambiguity line, the unverified preference claim, explicit repo-fit kept / ac-fit clear lines, the two absolute sibling read paths with the verbatim parent-owned missing line anchored at /repos/reports, the team/viewer group and Idea mention, the scenario footer with named-only attachments and preserved 12-row expectation, and the three degradation outcomes. Two wording spots are worth tightening so they do not read as regressions on reruns: the new 'Review precondition … Pick one, once the prescribed review precondition is completed' phrasing sits between the audit and the menu and could be read by a strict judge as inserting a second gate before the existing one—prefer Before's pattern of stating the roast disposition inline ('roast unavailable (tools disabled)') or an explicit 'this is not a gate; it runs before the menu renders' sentence. Also, After drops Before's one-line note that viewer's https stored origin and ssh configured URL both resolve to example.test/team/viewer; restoring that sentence makes the shared stored-origin identity parsing from the Change visible in the prepare checkpoint rather than implicit. Relocating the reporter and preference sentences above the footers is fine but state it as a conformance-only move so the byte-lock reads as intentional.
